suggested_change: Separate 'Evidence Quality' (what was said) from 'Information Completeness' (what remains unknown). Allow 8/10 scores for validated information even when other fields are unknown. For Decision Process: score 8/10 only if deadline verbatim confirmed in current call OR cumulative state explicitly tagged 'verified in call [DATE]'. For next steps: require either (a) specific contact + date or (b) explicit 'awaiting contact information' note—don't penalize for unknowns. For Competition: define 5/10 as 'incumbent identified, alternatives unknown' rather than 'partial mapping confirmed.'
